_comment: Duopilo texts, English (default and fallback). Flat keys, named placeholders {name} or {name:format}. Keys starting with log. are log texts: English only, never translated (logs stay English for issues and contributors). See docs/i18n.md.
language.name: English
tools.traffic.radiusLimited: Radius limited to {max} NM (200 km) – SimConnect doesn't accept more.
tools.traffic.noFlight: No flight loaded (main menu or loading screen).
tools.traffic.noOwnPosition: Own position unknown – traffic can't be computed relative to the aircraft.
tools.traffic.noResponse: MSFS didn't answer the traffic query. Is a flight running? Otherwise check duopilo_status.
tools.traffic.incomplete: MSFS didn't answer completely – some targets may be missing.
tools.traffic.noneMaybeDisabled: No traffic within {radius} NM. If that can't be right: AI traffic or multiplayer is probably turned off in the sim.
tools.traffic.noneAirborne: No airborne traffic within {radius} NM (only aircraft on the ground).
tools.common.notConnected: No connection to Microsoft Flight Simulator. Duopilo connects automatically as soon as MSFS is running.
tools.status.systems.egtImplausible: ENG {engine}: EGT {egt:0} °C with the engine running – implausible (extreme weather or air start?).
tools.status.systems.fuelFlowZeroProfile: ENG {engine}: fuel flow 0 with the engine running – check the fuelFlowKgh variable in profile {profile}.
tools.status.systems.fuelFlowZeroGeneric: ENG {engine}: fuel flow 0 with the engine running – there's no profile for this aircraft and the generic SimVar gives nothing here.
tools.status.navigation.gpsEmpty: The sim's GPS flight plan variables are empty – this aircraft's FMS doesn't feed them. Use get_progress (SimBrief) for route and progress.
tools.status.profile.none: There's no profile for this aircraft. Profiles are in {path}.
tools.status.autopilot.genericNote: Generic SimVars – may not be meaningful on study-level airliners. A/THR status is unknown without a profile.
tools.flightplan.noRoute: The SimBrief plan contains no usable route.
tools.flightplan.fmsNotInPlan: The FMS is flying to a point that isn't in the SimBrief plan – next fix and distances come from the plan.
tools.flightplan.terminalArea: In the SID/STAR or airport area the flight path often deviates from the plan (vectors).
tools.input.disabledNote: Input is disabled – the pilot can enable it in the Duopilo dashboard.
tools.input.readBack: Read this back to the pilot now and wait for 'confirm'. Then call confirm_action with the token and the pilot's words.
tools.input.readBackThenCaution: Read this back to the pilot now and wait for 'confirm'. Then call confirm_action with the token and the pilot's words – a caution with a second confirmation follows.
tools.input.readCaution: Do not execute yet: read the 'caution' text to the pilot word for word and wait for 'confirm'. Then call confirm_action again with the same token.
tools.atc.clearanceNote: Not every clearance sets this variable – in the test flight IFR and LANDING stayed at 0.
tools.atc.designatorUnknown: L/C/R isn't available via SimConnect and doesn't match any runway in the SimBrief plan.
tools.atc.sessionHint: The session starts with the first radio call (atc_transmit) or atc_control start. A saved session of the same flight is continued.
tools.atc.deviationHint: ATC has pointed this out. Offer the pilot to reset it with prepare_action (actions) – Duopilo never resets on its own, and only confirm after the pilot's answer.
tools.monitor.noEcam: No ECAM lines are defined in this aircraft's profile – only master warning/caution.
host.restart.unavailable: Restarting is only possible in the tray instance on Windows.
host.security.publicUrlInvalid: PublicUrl must be an https address without a path
remote.consent.title: Duopilo – allow access
remote.consent.heading: Allow access to Duopilo?
remote.consent.request: {client} wants to read the flight data from your Microsoft Flight Simulator.
remote.consent.loopbackWarning: The redirect goes to a local address. That's normal for Claude Code – only approve if you just started the connection yourself.
remote.consent.locked: Too many wrong passwords. Approval is locked until {until:HH:mm}.
remote.consent.unknownClient: Unknown client. Please restart the connection in Claude.
remote.consent.redirectNotRegistered: This redirect address isn't registered for the client.
remote.consent.expired: The request has expired. Please restart the connection in Claude.

remote.error.heading: That didn't work
remote.mcp.unauthorized: Duopilo: access only with a valid token.
remote.oauth.codeInvalid: Code invalid, expired or already used.
remote.oauth.refreshTokenOtherClient: Refresh token belongs to another client.
settings.simbrief.usernameTooLong: The SimBrief username is too long (64 characters max).
settings.simbrief.pilotIdDigits: The Pilot ID consists of digits only (simbrief.com → Account Settings).
settings.language.saved: Language: {name} – applies right away. Callouts, checklists, FMA calls, warnings and radio stay in English.
settings.smalltalk.unavailable: First officer and small talk aren't available in this Duopilo instance.
settings.smalltalk.modelInvalid: Model: at most 100 characters, no spaces.
settings.smalltalk.urlInvalid: Address: http:// or https:// with a host, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:11434.
settings.smalltalk.keyInvalid: API key: no spaces, at most 400 characters.
settings.smalltalk.voiceInvalid: Unknown voice "{voice}" – choose one from the list.
settings.smalltalk.saved: First officer and small talk saved – {provider}, applies right away.
settings.smalltalk.savedOff: First officer saved – small talk off.
settings.claude.publicUrlInvalid: The public address must start with https:// and must not have a path, e.g. https://duopilo.example.com (without /mcp).
settings.claude.passwordTooShort: The consent password needs at least {min} characters.
settings.token.created: New bearer token saved – copy it now, it's shown only once
settings.voice.trayOnly: The voice loop is only available in the tray instance (HTTP mode).
settings.restart.trayOnly: Restart is only available in the tray instance (HTTP mode).
settings.tunnel.noPublicUrl: No public address set – Claude can only reach Duopilo locally (Claude Desktop, Claude Code).
settings.tunnel.publicUrlInvalid: The public address is invalid (https:// without a path).
settings.tunnel.ok: Tunnel is up: {host} reaches this Duopilo instance.
settings.tunnel.blocked: Cloudflare blocks this computer (HTTP 403) – probably the WAF rule that opens /mcp only for Claude. That's intended; the tunnel can't be checked from here then.
settings.tunnel.hostRejected: Duopilo rejected the host name (HTTP 400). Does the public address match the tunnel's host name?
settings.tunnel.originUnreachable: Cloudflare can't reach Duopilo (HTTP {code}). Is cloudflared running, and does the tunnel point to {httpUrl}?
settings.tunnel.unreachable: {url} not reachable: {message} – check the DNS record and the tunnel.
settings.file.invalidJson: {file} isn't valid JSON ({message}). Please fix the file by hand – Duopilo won't change it like this.
settings.file.noWriteAccess: No write access to {path}. If Duopilo is in a protected folder (e.g. C:\Program Files) without the file from the installer, create {file} once by hand or give your user write access to it.
report.context.heading: HDG {heading:000}°
report.context.olderCalls: ({count} older calls in the local copy)
report.body.description: What is wrong, and what would be right?
report.body.shortened: … (shortened, full text in the local copy)
report.error.captureMissing: The snapshot is gone (Duopilo restarted?). Please open the report again.
report.error.empty: Please pick a type or briefly describe what's wrong.
tray.balloon.runningText: Duopilo now lives here in the notification area. Double-click opens the dashboard.
tray.balloon.simconnectText: Duopilo needs the MSFS 2024 SDK. Click here – the dashboard offers to install it from Microsoft.
tray.balloon.profilesWithErrors: {count} profiles loaded, {errors} with errors – details in the dashboard.
dashdata.speech.trayOnly: Speech output is only available in the tray instance (HTTP mode).
sim.read.noResponse: No answer from MSFS – the variable name or unit is probably invalid.
sim.command.timeout: MSFS didn't accept the command in time.
sim.ai.modelsUnsupported: The loaded SimConnect library can't list aircraft models (EnumerateSimObjectsAndLiveries, MSFS 2024 SDK needed). Give the title yourself.
sim.ai.createNoAnswer: MSFS didn't create the aircraft (no object ID within 10 s). Check the title with traffic_test_models; the runway must be within the area around your aircraft.
sim.ai.createFailed: MSFS didn't create the aircraft: {exception}. Check title and livery with traffic_test_models; the runway must be within the area around your aircraft.
sim.ai.createUnsupported: The loaded SimConnect library can't create AI aircraft.
traffic.connection.retryLater: Traffic connection to MSFS not available right now – retrying in a few seconds.
traffic.connection.openFailed: Can't open the traffic connection to MSFS (HRESULT 0x{hr:X8}).
traffic.connection.notAcknowledged: MSFS didn't acknowledge the traffic connection.
traffic.connection.callFailed: Traffic query to MSFS failed ({call}, HRESULT 0x{hr:X8}).
traffic.rules.closed: Runway {runway} is closed for Duopilo's traffic{note}.
traffic.rules.wake: Runway {runway}: the {type} is {wake}, at most {maxWake} is allowed{note}.
traffic.rules.tooShort: Runway {runway} is {lengthM:0} m long, the {type} needs about {needM:0} m.
traffic.rules.tooNarrow: Runway {runway} is {widthM:0} m wide, the {type} needs {needM:0} m.
traffic.rules.mix: {airport}: the {type} isn't part of the traffic mix ({types}){note}.
traffic.rules.directoryMissing: {file} is missing – airports are not classified, all traffic everywhere.
traffic.connection.closeIncomplete: no complete answer three times in a row
traffic.verdict.emptyConfirmed: confirmed: {count} empty replies with dwSize {range} bytes instead of {legacy} – up to 0.9 Duopilo read past the end
traffic.verdict.emptyRefuted: refuted: empty replies have dwSize {range} bytes
traffic.verdict.shortConfirmed: confirmed: {short} of {total} data messages too short (smallest data block {minBytes} bytes)
traffic.verdict.shortNotSeen: not observed so far ({total} data messages, dwSize {range} bytes)
aircraft.action.flapsWithoutChoice: Action {id}: flapsSpeed needs a choice of flap positions
aircraft.limits.vloMissing: limits.vloKt/vleKt missing – gear.down only with confirmation
aircraft.limits.maxGearAltitudeMissing: limits.maxGearAltitudeFt missing – gear.down in flight only with confirmation
aircraft.limits.vfeMissing: limits.vfeKt missing for {action} {positions} – only with confirmation
aircraft.limits.speedbrakeInhibitMissing: limits.speedbrakeInhibitFlaps missing – speedbrake with flaps extended only with confirmation
aircraft.limits.msaSourceMissing: limits.msaSource missing – FCU altitude only with confirmation
aircraft.limits.msaSourceUnknown: limits.msaSource "{source}" unknown (possible: {known}) – FCU altitude only with confirmation
flightplan.simbrief.notConfigured: SimBrief isn't set up. Enter your username or pilot ID in the dashboard under Settings → SimBrief (or in appsettings.Local.json under Duopilo:SimBrief).
input.plan.noSteps: {id} has no steps in the profile.
input.plan.stepEventOrSet: {id}: every step needs exactly one of "event" or "set".
input.plan.valueTooLarge: {id}: value {value} doesn't fit into an event.
input.plan.noStepForOption: {id}: the profile has no step for "{option}".
input.plan.noCheckForOption: {id}: the profile has no check for "{option}".
input.safety.eventForbidden: {event} is blocked (engine, fire, fuel, thrust, MCDU, sim control)
input.safety.eventNotAllowed: {event} is not on the list of allowed events
input.safety.circuitNotAllowed: circuit {circuit} is not allowed (lighting circuits only)
input.safety.onlyLVariables: {variable}: only L: variables may be written
input.safety.variableForbidden: {variable} is blocked (engine, fire, fuel, MCDU, sim control; gear/flaps/spoilers only via their events)
input.safety.areaForbidden: Area {area} is blocked (engine, fuel, fire, hydraulics, IDG – never via Duopilo)
input.safety.idForbidden: {id} is blocked (engine, fuel, fire, hydraulics, IDG – never via Duopilo)
input.safety.canonicalId: {step} ({what}) only under {ids} – that's where the safety interlocks apply
input.interlock.empty: Empty interlock in the profile – action locked.
input.interlock.groundUnknown: Not clear whether the aircraft is on the ground – locked.
input.interlock.vloMissing: VLO/VLE missing in the profile – gear only with a second confirmation.
input.interlock.vfeMissing: VFE for flaps {option} missing in the profile – only with a second confirmation.
input.interlock.flapsOverspeed: Flaps {option} locked: {ias:0} kt above VFE {vfe:0} kt.
input.interlock.unknown: Unknown interlock "{name}" in the profile – action locked.
input.safety.gearTooHigh: Gear locked: {altitude:0} ft, extend only below {max:0} ft.
input.safety.batteriesGroundUnknown: Not clear whether the aircraft is on the ground – batteries stay on.
input.safety.batteriesInFlight: Switching the batteries off in flight is locked – on the ground only.
input.safety.otherPackOff: {pack} is already off – both packs off on the ground only (loss of pressurization).
input.safety.apuBleedOn: APU bleed is on – set apu.bleed off first, then APU master off.
input.safety.adirsGroundUnknown: Not clear whether the aircraft is on the ground – ADIRS stay on.
input.safety.adirsInFlight: ADIRS off in flight is locked – attitude and navigation data would be lost, no realignment possible in the air.
input.caution.gearAltitudeMissing: maxGearAltitudeFt missing in the profile – gear only with a second confirmation.
input.caution.flapsUnknown: Flap position unknown – speedbrake only with a second confirmation.
input.caution.speedbrakeFlapsMissing: Flaps {flaps} and speedbrakeInhibitFlaps missing in the profile – speedbrake only with a second confirmation.
input.caution.otherPackUnknown: {pack} state not readable – in flight only with a second confirmation (both off = loss of pressurization).
input.caution.apuBleedUnknown: APU bleed state not readable – APU master off only with a second confirmation.
input.caution.xpdrStandby: Transponder STBY in flight – ATC no longer sees altitude or identification, TCAS is off.
input.caution.altReportingOff: ALT RPTG off in flight – ATC and other aircraft's TCAS no longer see our altitude.
input.caution.tcasStandby: TCAS STBY in flight – no more traffic advisories and no resolution advisories.
input.caution.squawk7500: Squawk 7500 is the hijack code – triggers an alarm at ATC.
input.caution.squawk7600: Squawk 7600 is the radio failure code – triggers an alarm at ATC.
input.caution.squawk7700: Squawk 7700 is the emergency code – triggers an alarm at ATC.
input.caution.adirsOff: ADIRS off – realignment needed afterwards (about 7–10 min).
input.caution.apOff: Autopilot {ap} off in flight – the pilot then flies by hand (unless the other AP is engaged).
input.caution.athrOff: Autothrust off in flight – thrust then by hand on the levers.
input.caution.msaSourceMissing: msaSource missing in the profile – FCU altitude only with a second confirmation.
input.caution.msaUnknown: MSA not available ({problem}) – FCU altitude only with a second confirmation.
input.caution.belowMsa: FCU altitude {target} ft is below the MSA {msa} ft ({source}).
input.caution.notCleared: FCU altitude {target} ft is outside the clearance ({cleared} ft).
input.caution.newerRequested: A newer action was requested in the meantime.
input.caution.superseded: A newer action was requested in the meantime – this caution is discarded.
input.rule.gearDown: only below VLO and below the maximum altitude (profile: maxGearAltitudeFt); then callout three green / gear disagree
input.rule.gearUp: only in the air; then callout gear up / gear disagree
input.rule.flaps: only below the VFE of the position; callout only once the position is reached
input.rule.speedbrake: extending not in the inhibited flap positions (profile: speedbrakeInhibitFlaps)
input.rule.packs: off in flight only while the other pack is on
input.rule.apuMaster: off not while APU bleed is on
input.rule.xpdrMode: STBY in flight only with a second confirmation
input.rule.altReporting: off in flight only with a second confirmation
input.rule.tcasMode: STBY in flight only with a second confirmation
input.rule.autoflight: off in flight only with a second confirmation
input.rule.fcuAltitude: below MSA (profile: msaSource) or outside the ATC clearance only with a second confirmation
input.rule.adirs: off locked in flight, on the ground only with a second confirmation
input.msa.noSource: no MSA source in the profile
input.msa.noMora: no MORA in the SimBrief navlog
input.verify.followUpGear: Gear position is being read back – callout "{callout}" once reached, otherwise "{failCallout}" after {seconds:0} s.
input.verify.followUpFlaps: Flap position is being read back – callout "{callout}" once reached, otherwise "{failCallout}" after {seconds:0} s.
input.verify.gearUnreadable: Gear position not readable – no callout. Check verification.gear in the profile.
input.verify.gearNotDown: Gear not down and locked after {seconds:0} s: {values}.
input.verify.flapsUnreadable: Flap position not readable – no callout. Check verification.flaps in the profile.
input.verify.flapsStillMoving: Flaps {target} not reached after {seconds:0} s (still moving: {values}).
input.verify.flapsNoMovement: Flaps {target} not reached after {seconds:0} s (no movement: {values}).
input.detail.confirmedByPilot: confirmed by the pilot in the cockpit
input.detail.voiceDirect: Voice command, executed without readback (execute + callout): {readback}
input.prepare.disabled: Input is disabled. Enable it in the Duopilo dashboard (Input) or with Duopilo:Input:Enabled.
input.prepare.unknownAction: Action "{id}" doesn't exist for {profile} – see list_actions.
input.prepare.superseded: A newer action was requested in the meantime – this preparation is discarded and has no token.
input.prepare.callCancelled: Call cancelled – no action was prepared. Start again with prepare_action.
input.precheck.noProfile: There is no profile for this aircraft, so no inputs.
input.precheck.staleData: Sim data out of date – input locked.
input.confirm.nonePending: No pending action – expired or already executed. Start again with prepare_action.
input.confirm.tokenMismatch: Token doesn't match the pending action ({summary}). Use the token from the latest prepare_action reply.
input.confirm.pilotDeclined: The pilot didn't confirm – action discarded.
input.confirm.notClear: No clear confirmation from the pilot. Read the readback and wait for "confirm".
input.confirm.tooFast: Read the readback first and wait for the pilot's answer.
input.confirm.disabledMeanwhile: Input was disabled in the meantime.
input.confirm.profileChanged: Aircraft or profile changed – please prepare again.
input.token.missing: No token given – use the token from the latest prepare_action reply.
input.token.retired: Token {token} belongs to {summary} – {fate}. Start again with prepare_action.
input.token.retiredOtherOpen: Token {token} belongs to {summary} – {fate}. Pending now is {open} – read its readback to the pilot and wait for the answer.
input.token.foreign: Token {token} belongs to {action} in another Duopilo instance – call confirm_action through the same connection as prepare_action.
input.fate.replaced: replaced by a newer prepare_action request
input.fate.expired: expired (no confirmation within the time window)
input.result.reverted: The aircraft took the value briefly and reset it – check the prerequisites in the cockpit (e.g. power).
input.result.notTaken: The aircraft hasn't taken the value (yet) – please check in the cockpit.
input.result.maybePartial: {reason} Possibly partly executed – please check in the cockpit.
input.verified.unknownAction: Action "{id}" doesn't exist for this aircraft.
input.verified.notConfirmed: Only store this when the pilot clearly confirms that it worked in the cockpit (e.g. "check", "confirm", "on", "avail", "running" or the action's name) – without negation.
input.verified.notExecuted: This action wasn't executed in the last 15 minutes – execute it first, then check in the cockpit.
input.verified.lastFailed: The aircraft didn't take the value on the last execution – find the cause first.
atc.service.unknownAction: Unknown action. Allowed: start, stop, restart, reload, say_again.
atc.service.noSession: No ATC session – send a radio call first or use atc_control start.
atc.service.noMatchingBackup: no matching backup for this flight.
atc.session.readbackOpen: Readback {readback} was still open when the session was saved – treated as done ({from} → {to}).
atc.deviation.squawk: Transponder on {actual}, ATC assigned {expected}. Offer the pilot a reset (prepare_action xpdr.code {expected}) – never without the pilot's confirmation.
atc.deviation.frequency: COM1 on {actual}, {station} is on {expected}. Offer the pilot a reset (prepare_action com1.standby {expected}, then com1.swap) – never without the pilot's confirmation.
atc.deviation.squawkCleared: Transponder back on the assigned squawk {expected}.
atc.deviation.squawkAdopted: Squawk {squawk} taken over from the transponder (MSFS ATC), previously {previous}.
atc.templates.notObject: The template file must be a JSON object.
atc.templates.correctionMissing: {id}: readback item "{item}" has no correction under "corrections".
atc.templates.voicePoolEmpty: voices.pool is empty – every station needs a voice.
atc.templates.machNotAllowed: {id}: speeds in knots only, not in Mach.
atc.templates.migrateCzqxMoved: {label}: Gander Oceanic moved from "CZQX" to "CZQO" – CZQX is now Gander Center (domestic).
atc.templates.migrateCzqxRemoved: {label}: old oceanic entry "CZQX" removed – CZQX is now Gander Center (domestic), oceanic is under "CZQO".
atc.templates.migrateVoiceMoved: {label}: fixed voice moved from FIR/CZQX to FIR/CZQO.
atc.airspace.vatSpyMissing: VAT-Spy data ({dat}, {boundaries}) not found – FIR boundaries from the OFP only.
atc.airspace.sectorsMissing: {file} not found – no sectors, one frequency per FIR.
atc.airspace.airlinesMissing: {file} (OpenFlights) not found – callsigns from atc-templates.json only.
monitor.alert.sinkRate: Sink rate {rate:0} ft/min at {height:0} ft radio altitude.
monitor.alert.todPlan: Top of descent reached according to the SimBrief plan.
monitor.alert.tcasRa: TCAS resolution advisory (FMA shows TCAS) at {altitude}.
monitor.alert.tcasClear: Clear of conflict – the TCAS RA ended at {altitude}.
monitor.alert.approachPhase: Managed speed {distance} NM before the destination, but the FMGC is still in phase {phase} – approach phase not activated.
monitor.landing.complete: 2000 ft: gear down, landing flaps set.
monitor.landing.completeSpoilers: 2000 ft: gear down, landing flaps set, spoilers armed.
monitor.pm.positiveClimb: Positive rate of climb after liftoff.
monitor.pm.noSpoilers: Ground spoilers not extended 3 s after touchdown.
monitor.pm.transitionAltitude: Transition altitude {altitude:0} ft – altimeters to STD.
monitor.pm.transitionLevel: Transition level FL{level:000} – altimeters to QNH.
monitor.fuel.deviationNote: Deviation worse by {change} {since} (threshold {threshold}) – check fuel burn and tanks, possible leak.

voice.loop.offNote: Off. Turn it on in the dashboard (Callouts → Voice → Voice loop) or in {file} with "enabled": true.
voice.loop.partEnded: Part of the voice loop stopped unexpectedly.
voice.status.trayOnly: The voice loop only runs in the tray instance (HTTP mode, dashboard http://127.0.0.1:5155/), not in the stdio instance of Claude Desktop.
voice.download.stalled: Download stalled – no data for a minute.
voice.download.checksum: Download of {file} rejected: SHA-256 {actual} doesn't match the expected {expected} – file deleted.
voice.firstOfficer.introduction: Hi, I'm {name}, I'll be your first officer today.
voice.smalltalk.englishVoice: Small talk in English – the first officer's voice only speaks English (for {language}: choose a Supertonic voice).
voice.smalltalk.noVoice: The first officer's voice doesn't speak {language} – small talk in English.

speech.piper.badWav: Piper didn't produce a readable WAV file.

profile.requires.bat1Off: BAT 1 is off – switch the batteries on first.
profile.requires.apuMasterOff: APU master is off – set apu.master on first.
profile.requires.extPwrNotAvailable: No ground power available – GPU not connected (EXT PWR AVAIL off).
profile.requires.batteriesOffGroundOnly: Batteries can only be switched off on the ground.

dashboard.settings.language.title: Language

dashboard.settings.smalltalk.title: First officer and small talk
dashboard.settings.smalltalk.hint: With the voice loop on, each flight gets its own first officer: a random name with a matching voice (never the voice of an ATC station). They introduce themselves at the briefing and also answer to their name. Optional small talk via a language model: only sentences that are neither a command, a query nor a radio call – callouts, warnings, checklists and radio always come first and interrupt it. The model never triggers anything. Applies immediately.
